description: Explore a time-free Muon schedule knob (D004 C0029/C0030, cyclical momentum). On the E059 tip, turn the Muon momentum from a graph constant into a per-step GPU schedule tensor that runs opposite to the LR triangle: 0.72 at step 0, falling linearly to 0.60 at peak LR, then rising linearly back to 0.72 at the end (mean ≈ the current 0.655). The Nesterov form, lr, SGD groups, Lookahead, resolutions and everything else stay fixed. Recapture all graphs in build. Run the official seeds plus dev seeds 3-12.
